name: Lydia A. Moore
mentions: Mrs. Lydia A. Moore returned from Minneapolis Sunday night, whence she was recalled by the accident to her son, Hayes.

In Memoriam.  DIED—Sunday morning, Oct. 25, of concussion of the brain, J. Hayes Moore.  The above notice comes like a shock to everyone in the Bad Lands. Hayes Moore was well known and liked here as a quiet, unassuming man who would go far out of his way…
